question: Can replacing only the upright raise-body fold/replant sequence with the existing direct measured-pose rise reach standing and finite walking from the exposed upright entry?

source_basis.physical_failure: The phase-246 upright raise drives both right knees from about +1.10 through zero to -1.05 while both left knees are already near -1.05; the body loses support and inverts.
source_basis.command_only_observation: On three exposed entry readings, 2322 original native calls reproduce exactly. Direct V12 ideal tracking reaches neutral without sign crossings and peaks at 0.5524407413520072 rad/s; V20 reverses all four right-side joints and peaks at 3.2308423993727997 rad/s.

control_composition.original_passive_entry: unchanged R10Q selector and source-verified entry API; original prone/partial routes retain priority
control_composition.raise_body: unchanged V12 measured_pose_rise_reference toward all-zero joints over its existing 360-command reference clock
control_composition.stance_handoff_and_dwell: unchanged V7 stance law selected by V20

alternatives.reason: The observed child is already settled upside down; extra time does not address the commanded folding.
It retains the asymmetric fold/replant trajectory after support is attained.

alternatives.option: Use the no-kick joint ramp unchanged for upright recovery
alternatives.reason: The existing entry law refuses measured joint-limit violations present at both exposed upright entries; its fixed positive-knee endpoint also differs from a direct rise to neutral.

alternatives.option: Direct V12 rise only in the upright branch
alternatives.reason: Uses an existing measured-pose law that moves both knee signs toward neutral, preserves the demonstrated prone/partial V20 path, and leaves all completion and time limits intact.

risks: Command-space ideal tracking does not prove physical support, clearance, settling or recovery.
The unchanged support transition may still leave too much angular motion for a direct rise.
The V7 handoff reference may disturb a newly raised body; the full retained tail must measure it.
A new DLL requires its complete dependency key and affected native/adapter/reader qualification; old qualification is not inherited.

first_diagnostic.question: Exercise source-verified upright direct rise, V7 standing, fresh V55 walking and the complete stop through the real launcher and reader.
first_diagnostic.coverage_adequacy: Only upright actuation changes. One fresh kicked child covers the changed branch; unchanged no-kick and partial/prone compatibility are first checked at the native/adapter interfaces. This diagnostic makes no paired-effect claim.

development_coverage.if_first_diagnostic_negative: Retain and close R10R development negative; no later declared R10R cells may launch.

if_first_diagnostic_positive.additional_cells_require: Fresh phase-246 pair is valid and positive; each later diagnostic is individually declared and gated.

zero_world_requirements: Cold replay and retain all 2322 diagnostic native responses and the exact compiled source bytes.
Test the new actual step API at source/owner/task/clock/energy/memory boundaries and all phase transitions; old Q, prone and partial APIs must retain their outputs.
Validate all unchanged walking, ramp, stationary hold and stop policies on the exact newly built DLL, with explicit dependency-key scope.
Exercise the real worker, publisher and independent Godot/Python readers for the mixed V20/V12/V7 controller sequence, including crossed owners and old step APIs.
Complete the applicable zero-world smoke gate and negative controls before every physical child.
next_execution_order: Implement a distinct source-verified native step API composing the original laws.
Build and bind the exact candidate DLL, then qualify its native and real production interfaces.
Run the single phase-246 kicked diagnostic after its complete safety gate.
Only if positive, run the fresh declared pair and gated additional branch diagnostics.
Only after adequate development coverage, preregister a fresh held-out finite population and complete single-use authority.
